title: Magnetic Weyl Super Calculus: Schatten-class properties, commutator criterion, and complete positivity
summary: We combine our previous results on magnetic pseudo-differential operators for Hörmander symbols dominated by tempered weights [arXiv:2511.07184] with the magnetic Weyl super calculus of Lee and Lein [arXiv:2201.11487, arXiv:2405.19964]. This allows us to extend some previous results on the semi-super and super Moyal algebra, as well as to prove boundedness, compactness, and Schatten-class properties of super operators.
